visible_text: 某数列的第 n 项为 2n-19。下列何者正确？ I. 25 为该数列的其中一项。 II. 该数列有 10 个负值项。 III. 该数列的前 n 项之和为 n^2-18n。 A. 只有 I B. 只有 II C. 只有 I 及 III D. 只有 II 及 III
reasoning: Statement I is true because solving 2n-19=25 gives n=22, an integer, so 25 is a term. Statement II is false because a_n<0 when n<9.5, yielding 9 negative terms (n=1..9), not 10. Statement III is true because sum_{k=1}^n (2k-19)=n^2-18n. Hence only statements I and III are correct, corresponding to option C.
